suite_version: 2   # suite v2 (DEC-0559, DEC-0566): twelve harder build tasks with v2 ids; the four review-catch tasks unchanged in content

cost_hint: {build: 7, review-catch: 8}   # USD per run before any actual exists (run-arms/run-ablation est_next fallback)

  - {id: a0_bare, label: A0, task_types: [all], toggles: {loa_mount: false}, phases: [BARE], effort: high,

  - {id: a1_full, label: A1, task_types: [all], toggles: {}, took_effect: [all_phases_present, oracle_closed, integrity_clean]}   # oracle_closed: cycle-131 FR-1 (DEC-0615); review-catch runs only, a build run passes it vacuously
  - {id: a2_no_sprint_plan, label: A2, task_types: [build], toggles: {sprint_plan: false},

  - {id: a4_no_gates, label: A4, task_types: [build], toggles: {gates: false},

  - {id: a0_bare_fable, label: A0F, task_types: [review-catch], toggles: {loa_mount: false, bare_model: fable}, phases: [BARE], effort: high,

  - {id: a1_review_only, label: A1R, task_types: [review-catch], toggles: {}, phases: [REVIEW],

  - {id: a1_no_dissent, label: A1N, task_types: [review-catch], toggles: {dissent: false},

rules:   # D-A5: pre-registered, mirrored in NOTES
  threshold_points: 0.03
  cost_lower_pct: 15
  bootstrap: {resamples: 10000, level: 0.90, paired: true, units: {hidden_test_pass_rate: tasks, defect_catch_rate: defects}, also_report: {defect_catch_rate: tasks}}   # DEC-0399
  primaries_by_arm: {build_only: [hidden_test_pass_rate], all_types: [hidden_test_pass_rate, defect_catch_rate]}   # DEC-0400
  cap_failure: counts_as_failed            # 0 on each applicable primary (DEC-0393)
  exclusion: {statuses: [degraded, contaminated, interrupted], mode: pairwise, inconclusive_above_share: 0.25}
  sensitivity_figure: cap_failures_excluded  # printed, never decides
  multiple_comparisons: none                 # expected false positives at 0.90 over 6 components printed
  drift_guard: {cli_version: fixed_per_batch, model_ids: fixed_per_batch}   # DEC-0407
  order: trial_major_seeded_shuffle_within_block
  took_effect_per_trial: true                # a miss → infrastructure_error, arm paused until --clear-arm (DEC-0418)
  predicates:                                # DEC-0416, DEC-0393, DEC-0530; d = arm − A1 point estimate, [lo, hi] its 90 % interval, c/w = cost/wall-clock Δ %; evaluated in this order
    inconclusive_by_degradation: "the arm's excluded share > 0.25 (whatever its interval; DEC-0393)"
    investigate: "else any applicable primary has lo > 0"
    keep: "else any applicable primary has d < -0.03 and hi < 0"
    inconclusive: "else any applicable primary has d < -0.03, or no valid pair"
    remove: "else every applicable primary has d >= -0.03 and (c <= -15 or w <= -15)"
    simplify: "else (every applicable primary within -0.03, cost similar)"
  review_catch: {defect_counts_once_across_gates: true, false_positive_dedupe: cited_region, verdict_accurate_iff: "CHANGES_REQUIRED when the key holds a high or critical defect, APPROVED when none"}   # DEC-0420
  inconclusive_extension_trials: 2
  h1: "a1_full beats a0_bare on at least one primary with the interval excluding zero, else halt before promotion"
  a4_sensitivity: "a4_no_gates worse than a1_full on hidden_test_pass_rate with the interval excluding zero, else harden tasks before acting on other arms"
  decision_states: [investigate, keep, inconclusive, remove, simplify, not_run_cut, inconclusive_by_power]
  mde_cut: 0.10   # sprint Task 3.4: an arm whose MDE at affordable trials exceeds this is pre-declared inconclusive_by_power and not run

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# pipeline-run.sh — the cycle-130 ablation pipeline executor (SDD §1.4 D-4.1 … D-4.10, §5.6)
#
# Runs ONE task under ONE arm: materialises a sandbox repository (the task's
# fixture tree, or the review-catch PR under pr/, plus the Loa mount from the
# pinned --source-tree), then drives Loa's phases as separate `claude -p`
# sessions inside it, records every phase, enforces the per-run cap and writes
# meta/pipeline.json. One executor serves every task type (D-4.1):
#   review-catch                      REVIEW → AUDIT
#   bug-fix | refactor | feature-build PLAN → IMPLEMENT → REVIEW → FIX? → AUDIT → FIX?
# A FIX runs only when the gate before it wrote a CHANGES_REQUIRED LOA-VERDICT
# trailer (the last `<!-- LOA-VERDICT {…} -->` line of
# grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/engineer-feedback.md resp. auditor-sprint-feedback.md);
# a FIX that does not run is recorded `skipped: true`.
# Arms edit the phase set (D-4.2): `sprint_plan: false` drops PLAN; `gates: false`
# ends after IMPLEMENT; `loa_mount: false` runs one BARE session (no mount);
# `flatline: false` keeps PLAN with the Flatline step off; `context_resets: false`
# runs PLAN, IMPLEMENT and FIX as ONE implementer session (`--resume <session_id>`
# from the first session's system/init event) while REVIEW and AUDIT stay separate.
# The suite's `phase_sets[<review-catch|build>]` and an arm's `phases` override the
# default phase list; the toggle edits above apply on top.
#
# Usage:
#   pipeline-run.sh --task-yaml F --arm ID --run-dir D --run-id R --trial N \
#                   --source-tree DIR --suite-file F [--max-run-usd 12] \
#                   [--executor container|host] [--image IMG] [--claude-bin B] \
#                   [--docker-bin D] [--phase-models JSON] [--phase-timeouts JSON] [--dry-run]
#
# Options:
#   --task-yaml F       task.yaml (SDD §3.2); its directory holds TASK.md
#   --arm ID            arm id declared in the suite file (`arms[].id`)
#   --run-dir D         run directory to create (must not exist or be empty);
#                       alias --workspace
#   --run-id R          run id recorded in pipeline.json
#   --trial N           trial number
#   --source-tree DIR   the pinned Loa tree the mount is copied from
#   --suite-file F      evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml (read with yq -o=json)
#   --max-run-usd USD   per-run cap (default 12; config evals.ablation.run_cap_usd)
#   --executor MODE     container (default; DEC-0411) or host
#   --image IMG         container image (default loa-ablation:258)
#   --claude-bin B      host-mode CLI (default $EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, else claude)
#   --docker-bin D      docker CLI (default $EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, else docker)
#   --phase-models JSON {"PLAN": "<model id>", …} override ($LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS)
#   --phase-timeouts JSON {"IMPLEMENT": <seconds>, …} override
#   --dry-run           print the phase plan and exit 0; nothing is created. Lines:
#                       `plan: task … arm … phases <labels>`, one `phase <n> <label> model=…
#                       max_turns=… timeout_s=… effort=… session=…` per phase, `sandbox:
#                       mount=loa|none overlay=head|base|none(<why>) config_variant=eval|none
#                       config_edits=<key=value,…>|-` (the arm's sandbox .loa.config.yaml edits),
#                       and `eval_only: true (…)` for an eval_only arm
#
# Run directory layout (DEC-0413 — the grader never reads meta/):
#   sandbox/     the agent's tree (its own .git initialised at `base`)
#   snapshots/   <label>.bundle + index.json ({IMPLEMENT|FIX1|FIX2: commit}) after
#                IMPLEMENT and each FIX
#   transcripts/ events-<label>.jsonl (stream-json), stderr-<label>.log
#   eval/        model-invoke.jsonl, cost-ledger.jsonl (copied out of
#                sandbox/.eval/ after every phase), adversarial-{review,audit}.json:
#                the gate envelopes, copied once when the gate ends (REVIEW → review,
#                AUDIT → audit; never overwritten, a symlinked envelope is not copied;
#                the phase record carries envelope_copied and envelope_sha256, the
#                eval/ copy's sha256 or null). Later phases cannot rewrite them (audit MEDIUM-A1).
#   meta/        pipeline.json, phase-<label>.argv.json (argv + captured env),
#                prompt-<label>.md, arm, arm-evidence.txt, arm-env, refused.json,
#                home/ (container mode: the per-run HOME; deleted at exit)
#
# Session (D-4.3, DEC-0394 as amended, DEC-0412): `claude -p <prompt> --output-format
# stream-json --verbose --model <id> --permission-mode bypassPermissions
# --dangerously-skip-permissions --setting-sources project --tools <list>
# --max-turns <cap> [--effort <v>] [--resume <id>]`, cwd sandbox/, with exactly this
# environment: PATH HOME LANG LC_ALL TERM TMPDIR CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK
# CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH
# GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GH_CONFIG_DIR=<sandbox/.eval/gh-empty>,
# the Bedrock route's pass-through keys when set in the driver's environment
# (AWS_REGION AWS_DEFAULT_REGION AWS_PROFILE AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
# ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL), and the
# arm's LOA_* variables (LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false for gates: false).
# A python3 -I exec shim closes every descriptor above 2 and keeps exactly those keys;
# values reach it through the environment, never argv, so AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
# appears in no argv, capture or log (phase-<label>.argv.json records it as "<set>").
# `timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15` bounds the CLI.
# Container mode (D-4.9, DEC-0411 as amended) runs the same command inside
#   docker run --rm --name <n> --user <uid>:<gid> --network bridge --read-only
#     --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=1g --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2
#     -v <run>/sandbox:/workspace:rw -v <run>/meta/home:/home/evaluser:rw
#     -w /workspace -e <KEY=value…> -e AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK <image> python3 -I -c <shim> … claude …
# Exactly two mounts. meta/home/ (mode 0700) holds a copy of $HOME/.codex/config.toml and
# a copy of $HOME/.codex/auth.json whose tokens.refresh_token is the placeholder
# "loa-ablation-no-refresh-token" (mode 0600; the real one is single-use and a container
# refresh burned the host's; the codex CLI treats a MISSING key as logged out, KF-048)
# when present, and empty .claude/ and .aws/; the CLI's session store
# lives there for the whole run, so A6's --resume works across phases. No ~/.claude
# file is ever copied. The directory is deleted at exit and on interrupt.
# image_digest = the image's RepoDigest or id (container), else the fingerprint (host).
# Versions: `fingerprint` is computed from the HOST toolchain; in container mode the
# toolchain that runs the phases is the image's (Claude Code 2.1.299, codex 0.162.1 by
# Dockerfile.ablation), so image_digest identifies the batch's versions. On 2026-10-15
# the host CLI was 2.1.300 while the image pins 2.1.299; every arm runs in the container.
#
# Cap and watchdog (D-4.6, D-4.10): while a phase runs the driver re-prices the
# stream's assistant-turn usage every $LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S seconds (default 1)
# from per-token prices fetched once per model (pricing.py; $LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON
# overrides) and SIGTERMs the phase when spent + estimate ≥ the cap (cap_turn
# recorded). After each phase the result's total_cost_usd (authoritative) plus the
# sandbox cost-ledger rows written during the phase are added; ≥ cap → cap_failure.
#
# Exit codes:
#   0  finished (any verdict)                                   status completed
#   1  agent error: a phase exited non-zero or timed out        status agent_error
#   2  infrastructure: usage, refused arm/type, mount/toggle failure, CLI/docker
#      or image missing, fixture path rule, leak guard          status infrastructure_error
#   3  cap failure (run stopped at the cap)                     status cap_failure
#   4  interrupted (SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP to the driver, or a phase killed from
#      outside)                                                 status interrupted
# pipeline.json is written for every exit except usage errors and --dry-run; it is
# rewritten with status `running` after each phase so a SIGKILLed driver leaves a
# record (ablation-row.sh reads `running` as interrupted).
# Closed mount (cycle-131 FR-1, SDD §5.2, DEC-0613/DEC-0622): for a review-catch task with
# the Loa mount, every answer-bearing path of the PR fixture under .claude/ is overlaid with
# the PR's own version (lib overlay_answer_paths; mode from task.yaml
# review_catch.overlay_mode, head by default, base the per-task fallback) right after
# mount_prompt_surface; copy_source (the source tree's HEAD) must equal source_commit, else
# the trial is refused (infrastructure_error). Order: mount_prompt_surface → overlay_answer_paths
# → apply_arm_toggles → apply_eval_config_variant → write_sandbox_grimoire → init_sandbox_beads
# → regen_sandbox_manifest → check_mount_closed (clauses (a)-(d) of took-effect.sh
# oracle_closed on the surface about to launch; a failure is infrastructure_error naming
# the clause and path, and no phase runs). An arm whose toggles set oracle_open: true (the
# eval-only open-mount arm) skips the overlay and the check and records mount_overlay=none.
# Every mounted arm runs the cycle-131 eval config variant (both gates' budget_scale: diff,
# budget_cents_max 600; evidence config_variant=eval). Toggle bare_model: fable runs the BARE
# phase on global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1 (it wins over --phase-models and the suite's
# phase_defaults for BARE). All evidence reaches meta/arm-evidence.txt before the first phase.
# Mount integrity (audit LOW-A2): after materialisation the sha256 of sandbox/CLAUDE.md
# and sandbox/.loa.config.yaml go to arm_evidence (claude_md_sha256, loa_config_sha256 =
# <hex>|absent); at finish both are recomputed into pipeline.json.mount_integrity =
# {claude_md, loa_config} each ok|changed|absent (loa_mount: false → both absent; null
# when the run stopped before materialisation). `.claude/` itself is covered by
# took-effect.sh integrity_clean.
#
# eval_only arms (cycle-131 FR-5): an arm declaring `eval_only: true` (a1_full_openmount) is
# refused — exit 2, `refused: arm '<id>': eval_only arm outside an evaluation batch`, before the
# run directory exists, so no pipeline.json and no infrastructure_error is ever written — unless
# LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT=1 (exactly 1). run-ablation.sh exports it to every trial it launches
# (batch and smoke); --dry-run honours the same variable, so the operator dry-runs the
# open-mount arm with `LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT=1 pipeline-run.sh … --dry-run`.
#
# Env: EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS, LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON,
# LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S, LOA_EVAL_CREDS_HOME (where ~/.codex is read; default $HOME),
# LOA_EVAL_CONTAINER_CLAUDE_BIN (default claude), LOA_EVAL_EXECUTOR, LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT.
#
# Mount library: lib/sandbox-mount.sh beside this script, sourced by a literal path.
# Exported to it: ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE, ARM_ENV_FILE (meta/arm-env), LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE.
#
# Tested by evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats (stub claude, stub docker, and a temporary
# copy of this harness whose lib/sandbox-mount.sh is the stub mount library).
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C
shopt -u patsub_replacement 2>/dev/null || true   # bash 5.2: '&' in ${x//p/r} stays literal

CLAUDE_BIN="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}" DOCKER_BIN="${EVAL_DOCKER_BIN:-docker}"

SPRINT="sprint-1"

die_usage() { echo "pipeline-run.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do

    --run-dir|--workspace) RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --run-id)         RUN_ID="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --trial)          TRIAL="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --source-tree)    SOURCE_TREE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --suite-file)     SUITE_FILE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --max-run-usd)    MAX_RUN_USD="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --executor)       EXECUTOR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --image)          IMAGE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --claude-bin)     CLAUDE_BIN="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --docker-bin)     DOCKER_BIN="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;

    --phase-timeouts) PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;

    -h|--help)        sed -n '2,156p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;

  esac

for v in TASK_YAML ARM RUN_ID TRIAL SOURCE_TREE SUITE_FILE; do

done
[[ "$DRY_RUN" == true || -n "$RUN_DIR" ]] || die_usage "missing --run-dir"
[[ -f "$TASK_YAML" ]] || die_usage "task yaml not found: $TASK_YAML"

for t in jq yq git timeout; do command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die_usage "required tool missing: $t"; done
[[ -z "$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" ]] || jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" || die_usage "--phase-models must be a JSON object"
[[ -z "$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON" ]] || jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON" || die_usage "--phase-timeouts must be a JSON object"
[[ -n "$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" ]] || PHASE_MODELS_JSON='{}'
[[ -n "$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON" ]] || PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON='{}'

TASK_YAML="$(cd "$(dirname "$TASK_YAML")" && pwd)/$(basename "$TASK_YAML")"
TASK_DIR="$(dirname "$TASK_YAML")"
SUITE_ROOT="$(cd "$TASK_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
SOURCE_TREE="$(cd "$SOURCE_TREE" && pwd)"

TASK_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$TASK_YAML")" || die_usage "task yaml does not parse: $TASK_YAML"
SUITE_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE")" || die_usage "suite file does not parse: $SUITE_FILE"

if [[ -z "$MAX_RUN_USD" ]]; then
  MAX_RUN_USD="$(jq -r '.caps.run_usd // 12' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
  cfg_cap="$(yq -r '.evals.ablation.run_cap_usd // ""' "$REPO_ROOT/.loa.config.yaml" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [[ -n "$cfg_cap" && "$cfg_cap" != "null" ]] && MAX_RUN_USD="$cfg_cap"
fi
[[ "$MAX_RUN_USD" =~ ^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$ ]] || die_usage "--max-run-usd must be a number"
CAP_MICRO="$(jq -n --arg c "$MAX_RUN_USD" '($c|tonumber) * 1000000 | round')"

TASK_ID="$(jq -r '.id // ""' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
TASK_TYPE="$(jq -r '.type // ""' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
[[ -n "$TASK_ID" ]] || die_usage "task has no id"
case "$TASK_TYPE" in
  review-catch) KIND="review-catch" ;;
  bug-fix|refactor|feature-build) KIND="build" ;;
  *) die_usage "task type '$TASK_TYPE' is not one of feature-build|bug-fix|refactor|review-catch" ;;
esac

OVERLAY_MODE="$(jq -r '.review_catch.overlay_mode // "head"' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
case "$OVERLAY_MODE" in head|base) ;; *) die_usage "task review_catch.overlay_mode must be head or base, got '$OVERLAY_MODE'" ;; esac

# --- arm and phase plan -------------------------------------------------------
ARM_DEF="$(jq -c --arg a "$ARM" '[.arms // [] | .[] | select(.id == $a)][0] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
ALL_ARM_IDS="$(jq -r '[.arms // [] | .[] | .id] | .[]' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
REFUSAL=""
if [[ -z "$ARM_DEF" ]]; then
  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' is not declared in the suite"
elif [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$ARM_DEF")" == "true" ]]; then
  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' is declared absent: true"
elif ! jq -e --arg k "$KIND" --arg t "$TASK_TYPE" \
       '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
       >/dev/null <<<"$ARM_DEF"; then
  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' does not apply to task type '$TASK_TYPE' (task_types $(jq -c '.task_types' <<<"$ARM_DEF"))"
fi
[[ -n "$ARM_DEF" ]] || ARM_DEF='{}'
SUITE_TOGGLES="$(jq -c '.toggles // {}' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"
# eval_only (cycle-131 FR-5): refused before anything is created, dry run included, unless the
# runner marks the batch context; no pipeline.json, so no infrastructure_error row is possible
EVAL_ONLY=false; [[ "$(jq -r '.eval_only // false' <<<"$ARM_DEF")" == true ]] && EVAL_ONLY=true
if [[ "$EVAL_ONLY" == true && "${LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT:-}" != 1 ]]; then
  echo "pipeline-run.sh: refused: arm '$ARM': eval_only arm outside an evaluation batch (run-ablation.sh exports LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT=1 to its trials)" >&2
  exit 2
fi

# plan_phases <toggles-json> → JSON array of {name,label}
plan_phases() {
  jq -c -n --argjson arm "$ARM_DEF" --argjson suite "$SUITE_JSON" --argjson tg "$1" --arg kind "$KIND" '
    ( if $kind == "review-catch" then ["REVIEW","AUDIT"] else ["PLAN","IMPLEMENT","REVIEW","FIX","AUDIT","FIX"] end ) as $dflt
    | ( $arm.phases // $suite.phase_sets[$kind] // $dflt ) as $p0
    | ( if ($tg.loa_mount == false) then ["BARE"] else $p0 end ) as $p1
    | ( if ($tg.sprint_plan == false) then ($p1 | map(select(. != "PLAN"))) else $p1 end ) as $p2
    | ( if ($tg.gates == false) and ($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) != null
          then $p2[0:(($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) + 1)] else $p2 end ) as $p3
    | reduce $p3[] as $n ({out: [], fix: 0};
        if $n == "FIX" then .fix += 1 | .out += [{name: "FIX", label: ("FIX" + (.fix | tostring))}]
        else .out += [{name: $n, label: $n}] end)
    | .out'
}

phase_skill() {  # the Loa skill a phase invokes (for effort_requested)
  case "$1" in
    PLAN) echo planning-sprints ;; IMPLEMENT|FIX) echo implementing-tasks ;;
    REVIEW) echo reviewing-code ;; AUDIT) echo auditing-security ;; *) echo "" ;;
  esac
}
builtin_model() { case "$1" in REVIEW|AUDIT) echo global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1 ;; *) echo global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5 ;; esac; }
builtin_turns() { case "$1" in PLAN) echo 30 ;; IMPLEMENT) echo 60 ;; REVIEW|FIX|AUDIT) echo 40 ;; BARE) echo 170 ;; *) echo 40 ;; esac; }
builtin_tmin()  { case "$1" in PLAN) echo 15 ;; IMPLEMENT) echo 25 ;; REVIEW|AUDIT) echo 20 ;; FIX) echo 15 ;; BARE) echo 70 ;; *) echo 20 ;; esac; }

BARE_FABLE_MODEL="global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1"
BARE_MODEL_TOGGLE="$(jq -r '.bare_model // empty' <<<"$SUITE_TOGGLES")"   # re-read from the library's toggles below
phase_model() {  # bare_model: fable (cycle-131 D-5.1) decides BARE over every other source
  if [[ "$1" == BARE && "$BARE_MODEL_TOGGLE" == fable ]]; then printf '%s\n' "$BARE_FABLE_MODEL"; return 0; fi
  jq -r --arg n "$1" --arg d "$(builtin_model "$1")" --argjson o "$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" \
    '$o[$n] // .phase_defaults.models[$n] // $d' <<<"$SUITE_JSON"
}
phase_cap() {  # phase_cap <name> max_turns|timeout_min — task bounds > suite phase_defaults > built-in;
               # BARE without a declaration = PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 × FIX
  local n="$1" key="$2" v
  v="$(jq -r --arg n "$n" --arg k "$key" '.bounds[$k][$n] // empty' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
  [[ -n "$v" ]] || v="$(jq -r --arg n "$n" --arg k "$key" '.phase_defaults[$k][$n] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
  if [[ -z "$v" && "$n" == "BARE" ]]; then
    v=$(( $(phase_cap PLAN "$key") + $(phase_cap IMPLEMENT "$key") + 2 * $(phase_cap FIX "$key") ))
  fi
  if [[ -z "$v" ]]; then
    if [[ "$key" == max_turns ]]; then v="$(builtin_turns "$n")"; else v="$(builtin_tmin "$n")"; fi
  fi
  printf '%s' "$v"
}
phase_timeout_s() {
  local o; o="$(jq -r --arg n "$1" '.[$n] // empty' <<<"$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON")"
  if [[ -n "$o" ]]; then printf '%s' "$o"; else printf '%s' $(( $(phase_cap "$1" timeout_min) * 60 )); fi
}
TOOLS="$(jq -r --arg d "$TOOLS_DEFAULT" '.phase_defaults.tools // $d | if type == "array" then join(",") else . end' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
EFFORT_FLAG="$(jq -r '.effort // .toggles.effort // empty' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"
case "$EFFORT_FLAG" in ""|low|medium|high|xhigh|max) ;; *) die_usage "arm effort '$EFFORT_FLAG' is not low|medium|high|xhigh|max" ;; esac

if [[ "$DRY_RUN" == true ]]; then
  if [[ -n "$REFUSAL" ]]; then echo "pipeline-run.sh: refused: $REFUSAL" >&2; exit 2; fi
  plan="$(plan_phases "$SUITE_TOGGLES")"
  single="$(jq -r '.context_resets == false' <<<"$SUITE_TOGGLES")"
  echo "plan: task $TASK_ID type $TASK_TYPE arm $ARM executor $EXECUTOR cap USD $MAX_RUN_USD phases $(jq -r 'map(.label + (if .name == "FIX" then "?" else "" end)) | join(",")' <<<"$plan")"
  i=0
  while IFS=$'\t' read -r name label; do
    i=$((i + 1))
    sess=new
    if [[ "$single" == true ]]; then case "$name" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) sess=implementer ;; esac; fi
    cond=""; [[ "$name" == FIX ]] && cond=" when=CHANGES_REQUIRED"
    printf 'phase %d %s model=%s max_turns=%s timeout_s=%s effort=%s session=%s%s\n' "$i" "$label" \
      "$(phase_model "$name")" "$(phase_cap "$name" max_turns)" "$(phase_timeout_s "$name")" \
      "${EFFORT_FLAG:--}" "$sess" "$cond"
  done < <(jq -r '.[] | [.name, .label] | @tsv' <<<"$plan")
  # the sandbox plan: the mount, the closed-mount overlay, the eval config variant and the
  # arm's config edits (the keys apply_arm_toggles sets in the sandbox .loa.config.yaml)
  if [[ "$(jq -r '.loa_mount' <<<"$SUITE_TOGGLES")" == false ]]; then
    sb_mount=none sb_overlay="none(no mount)" sb_variant=none sb_edits=-
  else
    sb_mount=loa sb_variant=eval
    if [[ "$KIND" != review-catch ]]; then sb_overlay="none(build)"
    elif [[ "$(jq -r '.oracle_open' <<<"$SUITE_TOGGLES")" == true ]]; then sb_overlay="none(oracle_open)"
    else sb_overlay="$OVERLAY_MODE"; fi
    sb_edits="$(jq -r '[ (if .companion_voice == false then "flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice=false", "flatline_protocol.security_audit.companion_voice=false" else empty end),
                         (if .gates == false then "flatline_protocol.code_review.enabled=false", "flatline_protocol.security_audit.enabled=false" else empty end),
                         (if .dissent == false and .gates != false then "flatline_protocol.code_review.enabled=false" else empty end),
                         (if .flatline == false then "flatline_protocol.enabled=false" else empty end) ]
                       | if length == 0 then "-" else join(",") end' <<<"$SUITE_TOGGLES")"
  fi
  printf 'sandbox: mount=%s overlay=%s config_variant=%s config_edits=%s\n' "$sb_mount" "$sb_overlay" "$sb_variant" "$sb_edits"
  [[ "$EVAL_ONLY" == true ]] && echo "eval_only: true (batch context LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT=1)"
  exit 0
fi

if [[ -e "$RUN_DIR" ]] && [[ -n "$(ls -A "$RUN_DIR" 2>/dev/null)" ]]; then

builtin_tmin()  { case "$1" in PLAN) echo 15 ;; IMPLEMENT) echo 25 ;; REVIEW|AUDIT) echo 20 ;; FIX) echo 15 ;; BARE) echo 70 ;; *) echo 20 ;; esac; }

BARE_FABLE_MODEL="global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1"
BARE_MODEL_TOGGLE="$(jq -r '.bare_model // empty' <<<"$SUITE_TOGGLES")"   # re-read from the library's toggles below
phase_model() {  # bare_model: fable (cycle-131 D-5.1) decides BARE over every other source
  if [[ "$1" == BARE && "$BARE_MODEL_TOGGLE" == fable ]]; then printf '%s\n' "$BARE_FABLE_MODEL"; return 0; fi
  jq -r --arg n "$1" --arg d "$(builtin_model "$1")" --argjson o "$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" \
    '$o[$n] // .phase_defaults.models[$n] // $d' <<<"$SUITE_JSON"
}
phase_cap() {  # phase_cap <name> max_turns|timeout_min — task bounds > suite phase_defaults > built-in;
               # BARE without a declaration = PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 × FIX
  local n="$1" key="$2" v
  v="$(jq -r --arg n "$n" --arg k "$key" '.bounds[$k][$n] // empty' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
  [[ -n "$v" ]] || v="$(jq -r --arg n "$n" --arg k "$key" '.phase_defaults[$k][$n] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
  if [[ -z "$v" && "$n" == "BARE" ]]; then
    v=$(( $(phase_cap PLAN "$key") + $(phase_cap IMPLEMENT "$key") + 2 * $(phase_cap FIX "$key") ))
  fi
  if [[ -z "$v" ]]; then
    if [[ "$key" == max_turns ]]; then v="$(builtin_turns "$n")"; else v="$(builtin_tmin "$n")"; fi
  fi
  printf '%s' "$v"
}
phase_timeout_s() {
  local o; o="$(jq -r --arg n "$1" '.[$n] // empty' <<<"$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON")"
  if [[ -n "$o" ]]; then printf '%s' "$o"; else printf '%s' $(( $(phase_cap "$1" timeout_min) * 60 )); fi
}
TOOLS="$(jq -r --arg d "$TOOLS_DEFAULT" '.phase_defaults.tools // $d | if type == "array" then join(",") else . end' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
EFFORT_FLAG="$(jq -r '.effort // .toggles.effort // empty' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"
case "$EFFORT_FLAG" in ""|low|medium|high|xhigh|max) ;; *) die_usage "arm effort '$EFFORT_FLAG' is not low|medium|high|xhigh|max" ;; esac

if [[ "$DRY_RUN" == true ]]; then
  if [[ -n "$REFUSAL" ]]; then echo "pipeline-run.sh: refused: $REFUSAL" >&2; exit 2; fi
  plan="$(plan_phases "$SUITE_TOGGLES")"
  single="$(jq -r '.context_resets == false' <<<"$SUITE_TOGGLES")"
  echo "plan: task $TASK_ID type $TASK_TYPE arm $ARM executor $EXECUTOR cap USD $MAX_RUN_USD phases $(jq -r 'map(.label + (if .name == "FIX" then "?" else "" end)) | join(",")' <<<"$plan")"
  i=0
  while IFS=$'\t' read -r name label; do
    i=$((i + 1))
    sess=new
    if [[ "$single" == true ]]; then case "$name" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) sess=implementer ;; esac; fi
    cond=""; [[ "$name" == FIX ]] && cond=" when=CHANGES_REQUIRED"
    printf 'phase %d %s model=%s max_turns=%s timeout_s=%s effort=%s session=%s%s\n' "$i" "$label" \
      "$(phase_model "$name")" "$(phase_cap "$name" max_turns)" "$(phase_timeout_s "$name")" \
      "${EFFORT_FLAG:--}" "$sess" "$cond"
  done < <(jq -r '.[] | [.name, .label] | @tsv' <<<"$plan")
  # the sandbox plan: the mount, the closed-mount overlay, the eval config variant and the
  # arm's config edits (the keys apply_arm_toggles sets in the sandbox .loa.config.yaml)
  if [[ "$(jq -r '.loa_mount' <<<"$SUITE_TOGGLES")" == false ]]; then
    sb_mount=none sb_overlay="none(no mount)" sb_variant=none sb_edits=-
  else
    sb_mount=loa sb_variant=eval
    if [[ "$KIND" != review-catch ]]; then sb_overlay="none(build)"
    elif [[ "$(jq -r '.oracle_open' <<<"$SUITE_TOGGLES")" == true ]]; then sb_overlay="none(oracle_open)"
    else sb_overlay="$OVERLAY_MODE"; fi
    sb_edits="$(jq -r '[ (if .companion_voice == false then "flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice=false", "flatline_protocol.security_audit.companion_voice=false" else empty end),
                         (if .gates == false then "flatline_protocol.code_review.enabled=false", "flatline_protocol.security_audit.enabled=false" else empty end),
                         (if .dissent == false and .gates != false then "flatline_protocol.code_review.enabled=false" else empty end),
                         (if .flatline == false then "flatline_protocol.enabled=false" else empty end) ]
                       | if length == 0 then "-" else join(",") end' <<<"$SUITE_TOGGLES")"
  fi
  printf 'sandbox: mount=%s overlay=%s config_variant=%s config_edits=%s\n' "$sb_mount" "$sb_overlay" "$sb_variant" "$sb_edits"
  [[ "$EVAL_ONLY" == true ]] && echo "eval_only: true (batch context LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT=1)"
  exit 0
fi

# --- run directory --------------------------------------------------------------
if [[ -e "$RUN_DIR" ]] && [[ -n "$(ls -A "$RUN_DIR" 2>/dev/null)" ]]; then
  die_usage "run dir exists and is not empty: $RUN_DIR"
fi
mkdir -p "$RUN_DIR"
RUN_DIR="$(cd "$RUN_DIR" && pwd)"
WS="$RUN_DIR/sandbox" META="$RUN_DIR/meta" SNAPS="$RUN_DIR/snapshots" TRANS="$RUN_DIR/transcripts" EVALD="$RUN_DIR/eval"
mkdir -p "$WS" "$META" "$SNAPS" "$TRANS" "$EVALD"
printf '%s\n' "$ARM" > "$META/arm"

# evals/tests/ablation-report.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 260 Task 3.8 (AC-3.10; PRD AC-8.1–8.3;
# SDD §5.12; DEC-0393, DEC-0399, DEC-0400, DEC-0416, DEC-0417, DEC-0434, DEC-0435)
#
# ablation-report.py on planted rows: fixtures/ablation-report/gen-fixtures.py writes four
# scenarios (main, boundary, exclusions, partial; the header there lists every planted
# number) into the file tmpdir; setup_file builds the full reports once against the
# real suite file evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml. AR-23 … AR-30 (Sprint 262): the suite_version
# partition, the not-testable / not-yet-decidable states (bd-wqbz3), the degradation guard on
# the H1 and A4 lines, and the degenerate single-task rate-fallback pair. AR-31 … AR-35 (Sprint 262
# R3, presentation only): the sensitivity H1/A4 lines, the batch record, precision and cost per true
# defect, the budget-matched baseline. AR-36 … AR-39 (Sprint 262 R4, report 1.2.1): the type-stable
# grader-version sort and the never-fatal batch record, one run directory per row, float suite_version
# keys, and version-less rows that never reach a decision. AR-40 … AR-42 (Sprint 262 R5, report 1.2.2): the
# arm_map provenance check before any listing decision, the never-fatal batch-record computation, and
# run-directory attribution by numeric trial with the rerun fallback; AR-38 also asserts the JSON type of
# every version value. AR-43 … AR-47 (Sprint 262 audit, report 1.2.3): inconsistent defects_missed ids read
# as the rate, the sanitized never-fatal text, a non-numeric or NaN cost_usd read as 0 with a note, the
# loud allow_nan=False failure naming the key, and the arm / task_id grammar before any path is built.
# =============================================================================

setup_file() {
  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
  export REPO_ROOT
  export REPORT="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/ablation-report.py"
  export SUITE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
  export FX="$BATS_FILE_TMPDIR/fx"
  mkdir -p "$FX"
  python3 -I "$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/ablation-report/gen-fixtures.py" "$FX"
  for s in main boundary exclusions versions degraded degraded-a4 degenerate-1 degenerate-2 degenerate-ids present ids-bad c131 c131-mixed; do
    python3 -I "$REPORT" --runs "$FX/$s/runs.jsonl" --manifests "$FX/$s/manifests" --suite "$SUITE" \
      --out "$FX/$s/report.md" --json "$FX/$s/report.json" >/dev/null
  done
}

setup() {
  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ar.XXXXXX")"
}

teardown() {
  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
}

dec() {  # dec <scenario> <arm> <jq path under the decision>
  jq -r --arg a "$2" ".decisions[] | select(.arm == \$a) | $3" "$FX/$1/report.json"
}

cmp_of() {  # cmp_of <scenario> <arm> <metric> <jq path under the comparison>
  jq -r --arg a "$2" --arg m "$3" ".decisions[] | select(.arm == \$a) | .comparisons[] | select(.metric == \$m) | $4" "$FX/$1/report.json"
}

report() {  # report <scenario> <out-prefix> [extra args]
  local s="$1" o="$2"; shift 2
  run python3 -I "$REPORT" --runs "$FX/$s/runs.jsonl" --manifests "$FX/$s/manifests" --suite "$SUITE" \
    --out "$o.md" --json "$o.json" "$@"
}

@test "AR-1 each rule branch on planted rows: -0.05 tight Keep, 0.00 at -20 % cost Remove, 0.00 similar cost Simplify, wide Inconclusive, +0.04 Investigate" {
  [ "$(dec main a2_no_sprint_plan .state)" = "keep" ]
  [ "$(cmp_of main a2_no_sprint_plan hidden_test_pass_rate .d)" = "-0.05" ]
  [ "$(cmp_of main a2_no_sprint_plan hidden_test_pass_rate '.hi < 0')" = "true" ]
  [ "$(dec main a3_one_voice .state)" = "remove" ]
  [ "$(dec main a3_one_voice '.c == -20')" = "true" ]
  [ "$(dec main a5_no_flatline .state)" = "simplify" ]
  [ "$(dec main a5_no_flatline '.c == -5')" = "true" ]
  [ "$(dec main a6_one_window .state)" = "inconclusive" ]
  [ "$(cmp_of main a6_one_window hidden_test_pass_rate '.lo < 0 and .hi > 0')" = "true" ]
  [ "$(dec main a7_effort_medium .state)" = "investigate" ]
  [ "$(cmp_of main a7_effort_medium hidden_test_pass_rate .lo)" = "0.04" ]
  grep -qF '| A2 | `a2_no_sprint_plan` | 12 tasks | -0.050 [-0.052, -0.048] | n/a (build-only) |' "$FX/main/report.md"
  grep -qF '**Investigate** | investigate: any applicable primary has lo > 0 (hidden_test_pass_rate)' "$FX/main/report.md"
}

@test "AR-2 exactly at threshold: d = -0.03 is not Keep and is Remove at c = -15 (inclusive) or Simplify; hi = 0 is not Keep (strict); w = -15 is Remove" {
  [ "$(cmp_of boundary a2_no_sprint_plan hidden_test_pass_rate .d)" = "-0.03" ]
  [ "$(cmp_of boundary a2_no_sprint_plan hidden_test_pass_rate .hi)" = "-0.03" ]
  [ "$(dec boundary a2_no_sprint_plan '.c == -15')" = "true" ]
  [ "$(dec boundary a2_no_sprint_plan .state)" = "remove" ]
  [ "$(dec boundary a5_no_flatline .state)" = "simplify" ]
  [ "$(cmp_of boundary a6_one_window hidden_test_pass_rate '.hi == 0')" = "true" ]
  [ "$(cmp_of boundary a6_one_window hidden_test_pass_rate .d)" = "-0.04" ]
  [ "$(dec boundary a6_one_window .state)" = "inconclusive" ]
  [ "$(dec boundary a6_one_window .rule)" = "inconclusive: d < -0.03 (hidden_test_pass_rate)" ]
  [ "$(dec boundary a3_one_voice '.w == -15')" = "true" ]
  [ "$(dec boundary a3_one_voice .state)" = "remove" ]
}

@test "AR-3 a cap failure scores 0 on the primary, is listed, and the labelled sensitivity figure (cap failures excluded) differs" {
  [ "$(jq -r '.cap_failures | join(",")' "$FX/exclusions/report.json")" = "excl-1-a2_no_sprint_plan-fb-01-t1" ]
  # fb-01: trials 0 (cap, the row says 0.9), 0.40, 0.40 → 0.266667 against a1's 0.40
  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a2_no_sprint_plan hidden_test_pass_rate '.pairs[] | select(.task_id == "fb-01") | .arm_value')" = "0.266667" ]
  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a2_no_sprint_plan hidden_test_pass_rate .d)" = "-0.011111" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.sensitivity.rows[] | select(.arm == "a2_no_sprint_plan") | .comparisons[0].d == 0' "$FX/exclusions/report.json")" = "true" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.sensitivity.label' "$FX/exclusions/report.json")" = "sensitivity (cap failures excluded) — no decision uses this" ]
  grep -qF '## Sensitivity figure: sensitivity (cap failures excluded) — no decision uses this' "$FX/exclusions/report.md"
  grep -qF -- '- `excl-1-a2_no_sprint_plan-fb-01-t1` (`a2_no_sprint_plan`, fb-01 t1, cap_phase IMPLEMENT, USD 12.00)' "$FX/exclusions/report.md"
}

@test "AR-4 a degraded cell is dropped from both arms (pairwise); --exclude-degraded false counts it" {
  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a3_one_voice hidden_test_pass_rate '.pairs[] | select(.task_id == "fb-02") | .diff == 0')" = "true" ]
  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a3_one_voice hidden_test_pass_rate '.pairs[] | select(.task_id == "fb-02") | .control_runs | join(",")')" = "excl-1-a1_full-fb-02-t1,excl-1-a1_full-fb-02-t3" ]
  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a3_one_voice hidden_test_pass_rate '.dropped[] | .run_id')" = "excl-1-a1_full-fb-02-t2" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.exclusions[] | select(.run_id == "excl-1-a3_one_voice-fb-02-t2") | .reason' "$FX/exclusions/report.json")" = "degraded: IMPLEMENT models_used global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5" ]
  report exclusions "$T/nodeg" --exclude-degraded false
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.decisions[] | select(.arm == "a3_one_voice") | .comparisons[0].pairs[] | select(.task_id == "fb-02") | .diff' "$T/nodeg.json")" = "-0.243333" ]
}

@test "AR-5 an arm with 11 of 36 cells excluded (30.6 %) reads Inconclusive-by-degradation although its valid cells read +0.05 with lo > 0 (guard first, DEC-0393); excluded rows are listed" {
  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a5_no_flatline hidden_test_pass_rate .d)" = "0.05" ]
  [ "$(cmp_of exclusions a5_no_flatline hidden_test_pass_rate '.lo > 0')" = "true" ]
  [ "$(dec exclusions a5_no_flatline .state)" = "inconclusive" ]
  [ "$(dec exclusions a5_no_flatline .label)" = "Inconclusive-by-degradation" ]
  [ "$(dec exclusions a5_no_flatline .excluded_share)" = "0.305556" ]
  [ "$(dec exclusions a5_no_flatline .rule)" = "inconclusive (degradation guard, evaluated first): excluded share 0.306 > 0.25" ]
  [ "$(jq '[.exclusions[] | select(.arm == "a5_no_flatline")] | length' "$FX/exclusions/report.json")" -eq 11 ]
  grep -qF '| `excl-1-a5_no_flatline-fb-01-t1` | `a5_no_flatline` | fb-01 | 1 | contaminated | contaminated |' "$FX/exclusions/report.md"

#!/usr/bin/env bats
# =============================================================================
# evals/tests/validate-suite.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 258 Task 1.11 (DEC-0424,
# sprint AC-1.13, SDD §3.2)
#
# validate-suite.sh on fixture suites built from the committed smoke tasks
# (fixtures/ablation/suite-lib.bash): each check's pass and fail — schema, the
# four-by-four counts (relaxed by --allow-partial), the test_command allowlist,
# hidden/manifest.json destinations, the fixture path rule, leakage strings in
# TASK.md / criterion / phase prompts, the suite file's task_types.
# =============================================================================

setup() {
  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
  VS="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/validate-suite.sh"
  SUITE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/vs.XXXXXX")"
  R="$T/suite"; mkdir -p "$R"
  # no phase prompts unless a test supplies them
  export LOA_EVAL_PHASE_PROMPTS_DIR="$T/no-prompts"
  # shellcheck source=fixtures/ablation/suite-lib.bash
  source "$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/ablation/suite-lib.bash"
}

teardown() {
  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
}

@test "VS-1 the committed suite (tasks/ and smoke/) validates with --allow-partial; without it, every type short of four tasks is one counts line" {
  CR="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
  n="$(find "$CR/tasks" "$CR/smoke" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -name task.yaml 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
  short=0
  for ty in feature-build bug-fix refactor review-catch; do
    c="$(cat "$CR"/tasks/*/task.yaml 2>/dev/null | grep -c "^type: $ty\$" || true)"
    [ "$c" -eq 4 ] || short=$((short + 1))
  done
  run "$VS" --smoke --allow-partial
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  grep -q "OK — $n task(s) valid" <<<"$output"
  run "$VS" --smoke
  [ "$(grep -c 'counts:' <<<"$output")" -eq "$short" ]
  if [ "$short" -gt 0 ]; then [ "$status" -eq 1 ]; else [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; fi
}

@test "VS-2 a four-by-four suite validates; one task short fails the counts unless --allow-partial; smoke tasks never count" {
  make_full_suite "$R"
  run "$VS" --root "$R"
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  grep -q 'OK — 16 task(s) valid' <<<"$output"
  find "$R/tasks/refactor-04" -delete
  run "$VS" --root "$R"
  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
  grep -q 'suite: counts: 3 refactor task(s) under tasks/, want 4' <<<"$output"
  run "$VS" --root "$R" --allow-partial
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  make_task "$R" smoke smoke-refactor-x refactor
  run "$VS" --root "$R" --smoke
  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
  grep -q '3 refactor task(s)' <<<"$output"
}

@test "VS-3 leakage: 'hidden', a hidden test stem, an arm id or a defect key in TASK.md, and a path in the criterion, are each listed" {
  make_task "$R" tasks bug-fix-01 bug-fix
  make_task "$R" tasks review-catch-01 review-catch
  echo "The grader keeps hidden tests." >> "$R/tasks/bug-fix-01/TASK.md"
  echo "See test_slug for the cases." >> "$R/tasks/bug-fix-01/TASK.md"
  echo "This run is the a1_full arm." >> "$R/tasks/review-catch-01/TASK.md"
  echo "Key: D01-decoy-flag-reanchor" >> "$R/tasks/review-catch-01/TASK.md"
  yq -i '.criterion = "fix src/textkit/slug.py"' "$R/tasks/bug-fix-01/task.yaml"
  run "$VS" --root "$R" --allow-partial
  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
  grep -q "tasks/bug-fix-01: leak: TASK.md contains the string 'hidden'" <<<"$output"
  grep -q "tasks/bug-fix-01: leak: TASK.md names the grader file stem 'test_slug'" <<<"$output"
  grep -q "tasks/bug-fix-01: schema: criterion names a path or file" <<<"$output"
  grep -q "tasks/review-catch-01: leak: TASK.md names arm id 'a1_full'" <<<"$output"
  grep -q "tasks/review-catch-01: leak: TASK.md names defect id 'D01-decoy-flag-reanchor'" <<<"$output"
  grep -q "tasks/review-catch-01: leak: TASK.md carries a defect key pattern 'D01-'" <<<"$output"

# TASK.md / criterion / phase prompts, the suite file's task_types.

setup() {
  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
  VS="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/validate-suite.sh"
  SUITE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/vs.XXXXXX")"
  R="$T/suite"; mkdir -p "$R"
  # no phase prompts unless a test supplies them
  export LOA_EVAL_PHASE_PROMPTS_DIR="$T/no-prompts"
  # shellcheck source=fixtures/ablation/suite-lib.bash
  source "$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/ablation/suite-lib.bash"
}

teardown() {
  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
}

@test "VS-1 the committed suite (tasks/ and smoke/) validates with --allow-partial; without it, every type short of four tasks is one counts line" {
  CR="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
  n="$(find "$CR/tasks" "$CR/smoke" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -name task.yaml 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
  short=0
  for ty in feature-build bug-fix refactor review-catch; do
    c="$(cat "$CR"/tasks/*/task.yaml 2>/dev/null | grep -c "^type: $ty\$" || true)"
    [ "$c" -eq 4 ] || short=$((short + 1))
  done
  run "$VS" --smoke --allow-partial
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  grep -q "OK — $n task(s) valid" <<<"$output"
  run "$VS" --smoke
  [ "$(grep -c 'counts:' <<<"$output")" -eq "$short" ]
  if [ "$short" -gt 0 ]; then [ "$status" -eq 1 ]; else [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; fi
}

run_trial() {  # run_trial <jid> <arm> <task> <type> <kind> <trial> <run_id> <task_yaml> <watchdog_s>
  local jid="$1" arm="$2" task="$3" type="$4" kind="$5" trial="$6" rid="$7" tyaml="$8" wds="$9"

    printf '%s run-ablation: %s attempt %d run_dir %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$rid" "$attempt" "$rd" >> "$tlog"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ablation-pipeline-stub.sh — stand-in for pipeline-run.sh in evals/tests/run-ablation.bats.
# Takes pipeline-run.sh's flags and writes a run directory that took-effect.sh,
# ablation-row.sh and run-ablation.sh read: meta/{arm, arm-evidence.txt, pipeline.json,
# phase-<label>.argv.json}, transcripts/{events,stderr}-<label>.jsonl|log (a system/init
# event with claude_code_version, a result event), sandbox/.claude/checksums.json (a
# mounted arm) and, for review-catch, the two dissent envelopes under eval/. No model call.
#   STUB_LOG       append "<run_id> <arm> <task> <trial> <run-dir basename>" per invocation
#   STUB_ARGV_LOG  append "<run_id> max-run-usd <amount|none>" per invocation (DEC-0567 cases)
#   STUB_ENV_LOG   append "<run_id> LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT=<value|<unset>>" per invocation
#                  (cycle-131 Sprint 264: the batch context run-ablation.sh exports to a trial)
#   STUB_COST      USD per run (default 2.5), on the first phase record
#   STUB_CLI       the init event's claude_code_version (default 2.1.299)
#   STUB_RULES     file of "<run_id glob> <mode>" lines; the first match wins. Modes:
#                  ok | agent_error (no transport signature on stderr or in the result
#                  event; the transcript carries an assistant message naming a rate limit) | transport (agent_error with
#                  "overloaded" on the phase stderr, every attempt) | transport_once (only
#                  in a run dir without an -r<k> suffix) | cap_failure | bad_evidence
#                  (checksums.json lists a file with the wrong hash: integrity_clean FAILs)
#                  | drift_cli (init version 9.9.9) | drift_model (models_used names
#                  another model instead of the requested one) | extra_model (the last
#                  phase's models_used holds the requested model and, beside it,
#                  global.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0 with 516 output tokens:
#                  a WebFetch summariser, DEC-0545) | hang (pipeline.json `running`, then sleeps) |
#                  hang_norecord (sleeps before writing anything) | zero_cost (cost 0) |
#                  agent_error_nocost (agent_error as above, reporting cost 0)
#                  | bad_overlay (an oracle_closed arm's review-catch run gets no overlay:
#                  took-effect.sh oracle_closed FAILs)
#   STUB_HANG=1    every run hangs (mode hang)
# A review-catch run of an arm whose took_effect lists oracle_closed (cycle-131) gets the real
# lib/sandbox-mount.sh overlay over its corpus fixture and a one-commit sandbox repository.
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C
TASK_YAML="" ARM="" RUN_DIR="" RUN_ID="" TRIAL="" SOURCE_TREE="" SUITE_FILE="" DOCKER_BIN=docker EXECUTOR=container IMAGE="" MAX_RUN_USD=none
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --task-yaml) TASK_YAML="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --arm) ARM="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --run-dir) RUN_DIR="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --run-id) RUN_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --trial) TRIAL="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --source-tree) SOURCE_TREE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --suite-file) SUITE_FILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --docker-bin) DOCKER_BIN="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --executor) EXECUTOR="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --image) IMAGE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --max-run-usd) MAX_RUN_USD="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    *) echo "stub: unknown flag $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done
[[ -e "$RUN_DIR" && -n "$(ls -A "$RUN_DIR" 2>/dev/null)" ]] && { echo "stub: run dir not empty: $RUN_DIR" >&2; exit 2; }
TASK_ID="$(yq -r '.id' "$TASK_YAML")" TYPE="$(yq -r '.type' "$TASK_YAML")"
[[ -n "${STUB_LOG:-}" ]] && printf '%s %s %s %s %s\n' "$RUN_ID" "$ARM" "$TASK_ID" "$TRIAL" "$(basename "$RUN_DIR")" >> "$STUB_LOG"
[[ -n "${STUB_ARGV_LOG:-}" ]] && printf '%s max-run-usd %s\n' "$RUN_ID" "$MAX_RUN_USD" >> "$STUB_ARGV_LOG"
[[ -n "${STUB_ENV_LOG:-}" ]] && printf '%s LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT=%s\n' "$RUN_ID" "${LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT-<unset>}" >> "$STUB_ENV_LOG"

MODE=ok
if [[ -n "${STUB_RULES:-}" && -f "${STUB_RULES:-}" ]]; then
  while read -r glob m; do
    [[ -n "$glob" ]] || continue

head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:1913 — excluding the eval_only arm from `components` removes it from the report entirely: its rows pass list_reason() (the arm is run by the suite, not absent), enter cells, but appear in no decision, no per-arm detail (`detail_arms` at line 2003 is baselines + components) and no listed section. The open-mount A/B the comment names is never rendered anywhere; the arm's spend produces invisible rows.
head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:1913 — a0_bare_fable is a baseline (A0 on the review model; the test comment at ablation-report.bats:189 itself calls it a control arm) yet it is counted as a component: it receives an arm-vs-a1_full keep/remove/simplify "decision" that has no meaning for a bare baseline and inflates the expected-false-positive count to 9. It should be excluded like a0_bare, or the suite should mark it.

head/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml:117 — stale comment "over 6 components printed"; the report (and AR-12) now prints 9.

content.text:
I wrote the review to `review.md`. Verdict: CHANGES_REQUIRED.

The repository outside `pr/` is not present, so everything below comes from the touched files alone. Two referenced scripts, `lib/sandbox-mount.sh` and `took-effect.sh`, could not be inspected.

**Blocking defects**

- **New arms never run by default.** The suite's `priority` list was not extended. run-ablation builds its default arm list from `priority`, so a batch started without `--arms` silently skips all four cycle-131 arms.
- **Review-catch-only components cannot decide.** The report gives any arm with `review-catch` in its task_types the `all_types` primaries. hidden_test_pass_rate then always has zero pairs, the "no valid pair" clause fires, and `decide()` returns inconclusive before the remove/simplify branches. a1_review_only and a1_no_dissent can never reach the outcomes they exist to test.
- **The eval_only arm vanishes from the report.** Excluding it from components also drops it from per-arm detail, and its rows are not "listed" either because the arm is run by the suite. The open-mount A/B the code comment names is rendered nowhere.

**Design and completeness**

- a0_bare_fable is a baseline but is counted as a component, so it receives a meaningless keep/remove verdict and inflates the false-positive count to 9.
- The new took_effect rule ids (review_only_phases, no_review_dissent_envelope) depend on functions in took-effect.sh that this change does not add or show. If they are missing, the new validator rule rejects the committed suite.
- The PR title promises a cycle-131 suite root with bounds 50/40 and an image self-check. None of that is in the diff.

**Minor**

- Stale "over 6 components" comment in the suite.
- The dry-run `config_edits` line and the validator's TOGGLE_VALUES both hand-copy the mount library's toggle table and will drift from it unnoticed.

The eval_only refusal itself, the batch-context export in run-ablation, the help-text ranges, and the new bats tests looked correct as written.
